notes.title: A trio of top-down Dungeon Crawlers reviewed, one old, one new and one coming soon
notes.notes:
I was recently offered a beta key for the upcoming Ampers@t dungeon crawler and then a curator key for the recently released Ouroboros Dungeon. What better time, then, to also review the classic crawler, Unexplored?

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/05/a-trio-of-top-down-dungeon-crawlers-reviewed-one-old-one-new-and-one-coming-soon

notes.title: Patch Notes - v031 - Day 2!
notes.notes:
Hey! Excited to get back here on day 2.

Here is the Patch notes for v031. I wanna thank the community for bringing those issues to me so promptly. <3

- [Improvement] Hold mouse button (or controller button) to attack
- [BUG] Skeleton and golem defense reduced, player always hits at least 1 damage.
- [BUG] Fixed when damage label sometimes appeared far away from the enemy
- [BUG] Fixed sword animation and speed
- [BUG] Removed elements from the environment that looked liked they could be interacted. This will in the future return as a new feature.
- [BUG] Sometimes a dropped item could prevent player to traverse over it. It's now fixed.

Have fun!

notes.title: Game has been released!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40349191/ed292f7faa8eb11f2754963003fc337a025e1238.png[/img]

Hey all!

I'm so happy to finally release my quirky little game about loot and dungeon crawling. I hope you enjoy this delight. It's all about choosing the right loot and creating your path of becoming the mighty hero. There is no right path! Enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40349191/13630b41ecfcdc6fde6999a518a391059a186de5.jpg[/img]

Level up to unlock new stats to your items! This will completely change the way you play you hero.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40349191/8607c05e6767758ebd4e373410643f08630478d8.png[/img]

Yay, have fun!

notes.title: Patch Notes v030
notes.notes:
Hey guys! First day! Excited to put the game out for you to play.

- Updated the music to a more extended version.
- Fix a bug where sometimes a lack of controller input would broke the game.
- Reduced the time you need to wait for an Item to be dropped after the enemy was killed.

Thank you for understanding! Cheers
Have fun!
